hero.description: Passionate about web and mobile development, I build modern applications with React, Next.js and Flutter. Alongside, I support businesses through my freelance activity. I am looking for a work-study programme in IT project management to combine my technical vision with a strategic and organisational approach.

paragraphs: Fullstack developer based in Rennes, I am completing my Bachelor's degree in software development. My education has allowed me to master web and mobile development, from frontend to backend.
Alongside my studies, I founded DVS Web, my freelance activity where I help businesses create their digital projects: showcase websites, web applications, e-commerce and SEO optimisation.
This dual role as student and entrepreneur allows me to combine technical rigour with hands-on experience, delivering concrete and high-performing solutions.

I am currently looking for a work-study programme in IT project management. My background as a developer gives me a deep understanding of technical challenges, which I want to complement with training in project leadership, team coordination and delivery management.

Professional showcase website for my freelance developer activity. Responsive black/gold design, smooth animations, contact form with Resend API, optimised SEO (dynamic sitemap, Schema.org) and GDPR compliance.
features: Mobile-first responsive design with adaptive navigation
Scroll animations and micro-interactions
Secure contact form with dual email sending
Server-side generated dynamic sitemap and robots.txt
Complete SEO metadata (Open Graph, Twitter Cards, Schema.org)
GDPR-compliant cookie banner

items.description: SaaS application for AI-powered CV generation. Integrates OpenAI (GPT-4o-mini) for content optimisation, Stripe for payments, and NextAuth with 2FA. 5 templates, ATS analysis and PDF export.
features: 5 CV templates (Modern, Classic, ATS-Friendly, Minimal, Creative)
ATS analysis: Score 0-100 with recommendations
AI suggestions for content improvement
OAuth authentication (Google, GitHub) + 2FA with QR code
Stripe payment (1 free template, premium at £4.99)
High-quality PDF export
Transactional emails (welcome, password reset, payment confirmation)

items.description: Cross-platform application for breeders and pet owners. Complete medical tracking, vaccines with automatic reminders, family tree, weight evolution and PDF export.
features: Complete profile per animal with photo and identification
Vaccine tracking with automatic reminders
Treatment and veterinary consultation history
Weight evolution chart
Interactive family tree
Complete health record PDF export

items.description: Full-stack web application for generating, customising and managing QR codes. Real-time preview, style templates, dashboard with filters, multi-format export and public sharing via unique links.
features: QR code generation from URLs or text with real-time preview
Advanced customisation: colours, size, error correction, centred logo, templates (Ocean, Forest, Sunset...)
Dashboard with search, filters (type, favourites) and multiple selection
Multi-format export: PNG, JPEG, PDF (A4) and ZIP for batch exports
Public sharing via unique links with tokens
Complete authentication with bcrypt hashing

items.description: Showcase website for a building painting company. FR/EN internationalisation, interactive before/after gallery, dynamic Google reviews, Leaflet map and secure form.
features: Complete internationalisation (FR/EN) with next-intl
Dark mode with preference persistence
Interactive before/after gallery with touch slider
Dynamic Google reviews via API
Interactive map with service area
Secure form with rate limiting and hCaptcha
